reviews.name: Madison Bates
reviews.text: I absolutely loved my experience at Royal Salon! Lillie did my hair and gave me exactly what I asked for. She took the time to answer all my questions, and the rest of the staff were so warm and welcoming. I'll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Christiana Newel
reviews.text: Brynn is an amazing nail tech! She always makes my vision come to life. I recommend her to everyone that is looking to get their nails done.

reviews.name: Brittany Wilkerson
reviews.text: Melissa gave me a great new head of hair! I am so happy to have finally found a great stylist, who also has great conversation with me! I have also gotten 2 massages here and they were fantastic! 10/10 recommended!!
